With the Manage Report Folders permission you'll see a Who has access panel when you select a folder.

  • Add a User or Public Group as a member and choose Read or Edit.
  • Membership automatically shares every report and dashboard in that folder with the member — no per-record sharing needed.
  • Remove a member to revoke their folder-based access.

Note: while folders are in Public Read Only mode, everyone can already view all reports/dashboards, so today these grants mainly control Edit. Once the org is switched to private folder access, Read grants become what lets members see the contents at all.
